title: Shinonome Ena — Card Story

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Enanan, how's your progress?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Uh... I'm going to need a bit more time to fix them up to a viewable state.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
(Sigh... K's been muted all this time.
Well, it's not like the pictures are ready to be shown, anyway...)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Argh, I can't seem to carry on...
Maybe I need more sugar.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <As if sugar has anything to do with work efficiency.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <No way. It helps me concentrate better.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Really... Oh, speaking of sugar...>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Take a look at this photo!
It's a really cute cake shop that I visited the other day.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
(Wow, that cheesecake looks delicious!
This cake here should get me some social media points too.)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: (Which shop is this, though...)

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Well, Enanan? Any thoughts on the photo?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <It's not bad, I guess. Is this shop behind the station?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Excuse me? This is one of my favorite shops.
You can't expect me to just share it with you for nothing.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: (So it's not behind... A shop in one of the spaces in front, then? There are a lot of different shops along that road, after all.)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
(I need more information...
I know! I'll search for the photo that Amia put up on...wait a minute.)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <What's wrong?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Hey! Why did you delete the photo?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Oh dear?
I did nothing of that sort. This is strange!>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: (Amia knew I would try to look for clues in the photo...)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Whatever. I'm going back to work now.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Haha, sorry, sorry! I just thought it would be better for you to stare at stuff like this rather than worry about work. Here you go, the shop's address.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Oh, you...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
(Should've done that right from the start.
This cheesecake really looks so good!)

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <This cake shop looks pretty nice, right?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's decent enough.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<I went with my friends, you know.
Do you have a friend you can go with, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Just so you know, I've got a friend or two as well, okay?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
(I went shopping with Airi the other day too.
Let me send her a text message...)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: (She replied so quickly! I knew I could count on you, Airi!)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: (Huh? Oh no... She has something on...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, can you give the CD jacket you borrowed back already?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Jacket? Oh, the one I borrowed to reference for my drawing. Here, this one, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why didn't you give it back if you were done already?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, wait.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you want?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're free this weekend, right?
Join me for something.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why should I? Not every day is a Sunday for me like it is for you. Laters.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Cheesecake.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: One of my group members told me about this nice shop. Here, this shop.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Says here they pay close attention to the richness of the cheese and the way they bake the cakes. Sounds good?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It also says they have limited stock available.
You're gonna go queue up from morning when you can't even wake up?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wake me up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You... Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, I have nothing on until evening on Saturday, anyway. But I'll only be joining you until my part-time job starts.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Good enough.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sheesh... I'll shake you out of bed on Saturday if it's the last thing I do, understand?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe, I DO have people I can go out with, see? Okay, let's unmute and get back to the cha—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Uh... I'm not muted...

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Did you hear that just now?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Aren't you glad your li'l bro's sooo sweet?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Sh-Shut up!>
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sigh... I have class today too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh yeah! Let me check the response to the selfie I posted before leaving.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Lots and lots of thumbs-ups!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh! This follower noticed I was wearing new accessories from a brand that I'd tweeted about before...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I have more followers too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Anyone notice that?
<Did I get more followers?> There...tweet!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe, can't wait to see how they react.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Whoa, class is starting already.
I wish I could read more, but oh well.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll save all that fun for after classes!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sigh, I'm so tired...
Okay, let's see how my followers reacted to that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ah, there are so many comments!

rows.Speaker: Comment 1
rows.Line: <You're right! You do have more followers!>

rows.Speaker: Comment 2
rows.Line: <Congrats, Enanan☆>

rows.Speaker: Comment 3
rows.Line: <Enanan noticed me...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehehe, they did notice after all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I should let the group know about this too.
Hm, I guess I could send a message instead of using voice chat.

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Isn't this a nice selfie?
It got me quite a lot of new followers today!>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <The light's too strong. That's a lot of overexposure.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Huh? It's not overexposure. I just have a fair complexion!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I can see Enanan reflected in the accessories. That's lovely.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<I was surprised when I saw that too!
I didn't know it was even possible!>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Oh, come on. You were totally aiming for that.
How many times did you redo the selfie, idler?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I don't idle!>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Oh, by the way, K!
I'll be finishing up the pictures I showed you yesterday once I get home♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Huh? No reply from her...
Are her notifications muted?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ah, Yuki messaged...

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Once you get home? Are you still on the way back? It's already quite late, so please be careful.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Yuki really notices the little things, huh?
So unlike Amia who's always trying to spout senseless stuff.)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Thanks. I'll be fine, I'm already almost home.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sent.
Okay, I should hurry back to finish up those drawings.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But before that...
Let me take a peek at my illustration account...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No responses at all even though I regularly update it with drawings...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And I haven't gotten any new followers either, even though my selfie account already has more than a thousand...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No comments on the drawings here, either...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whereas the selfie account gets so many reactions...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, a notification?!

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to the new illustrations.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to finish the drawings quickly and show them to K!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki should be here any moment...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey there, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sheesh. You barely made it on time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was you who asked me to help you practice singing, so at least make the effort not to keep me waiting.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What are you talking about? I'm five minutes early, and anyway, it's acceptable to turn up five minutes late.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh... Were you so excited that I wanted to meet up with you that you arrived an hour early?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry to burst your bubble but no one'd get that excited to see you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I arrived fifteen minutes early, as any reasonable person would.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, so you make an effort when it comes to some things.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What are you implying?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, are we going to just stand here chatting or are we going to karaoke?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, is that where we're going to practice?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. Sorry I'm being so cheap, but I'm kind of broke until my payday next week.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting you to book a studio just for us...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Karaoke's convenient, and the booths are cozy! Come on, let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: H-Hey, don't leave me behind!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Phew! I sang my heart out!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We've always been recording our parts separately, so it was hard to get the harmony right, but this helped me grasp how it should work way better.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, are we going home now? I think we both have had enough singing for the day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I don't wanna go home just yet!
Since we're out here anyway, let's go shopping!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
See that store over there?
They just got revamped. Let's check it out!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmph, it's mostly accessories?
Oh, this choker's cute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I think this one has a nicer design.
Let's see how it'd look on you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Not too bad.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Liar, I can tell you like it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You can be so annoying.
It's okay, but not perfect. Now, if they had it in a different color...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They do. Try this one!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, okay, this one's pretty nice.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Glad you like it!
By the way, I was going to look for some hair accessories.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How do you like this one?
It goes with your hair color.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's really pretty!
But it's not the sort of thing I'd pick out myself. Can you clip it on for me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, just a moment... There. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, it does suit me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I think it'll look even better with a brighter outfit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're right!
You opened my eyes to a cute new style!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm really strapped for cash this week, but I just have to get this. Thanks, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... No problem...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Why did you suddenly go so docile?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I didn't, sheesh.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, there's definitely something going on there! Tell me! If you don't, I'll tell Kanade and Mafuyu that you've been mean to me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're so obnoxious!
I just thought you'd be harder to get along with.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's what you were thinking?
No one will like you if you say things like that, you know!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
THAT'S what I mean!
You're so hard to get along with!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha, sorry about that♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So that's what you thought, eh?
Have I managed to convince you I'm not that bad?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You get on my nerves sometimes, but I get it now that it's just teasing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah? So, what's the verdict?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you want to hear? I don't really know what to say.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I thought only Kanade, who recognized my art, saw me for who I really was...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But maybe it wasn't just her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cat got your tongue, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Since I got to know you a bit better, it's more fun working together. That's all I've got to say.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And what about you?
Did your opinion of me change since we started hanging out together?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... I haven't thought about it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? You got me to talk but you won't?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: More importantly, there's a cool-looking store there!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, don't change the subject!
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Aaand now... It's done!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll show it to Kanade and ask what she thinks. Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's strange. No one else is online?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No matter, I'll just post this and leave her a message.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, I got a notification!
Could this be...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yay!
I got a new follower♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe, my last selfie was totally cute!
It got lots of likes!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My illustration account isn't getting any attention at all...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Two new followers since last week?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's check them out...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Their usernames are...Amia and Yuki?
Are they Mizuki and Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But why did they follow my account out of the blue...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anyone there?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, it's 1:00AM already!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'm here!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I just logged in too.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Same.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I see you've uploaded the illustration, Ena. Hold on, I'm opening the file.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, cool. I'll check it out too.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Me too.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <S-Sure.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'd like to ask them if they followed my account, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <By the way, I saw that new illustration you posted the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You did? And...did you like it?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah, I thought it was great.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <R-Really?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I saw it too, nice work.
It has that unique Enanan style.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yeah.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So... It was you guys who followed my account this week?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I guess so? K's been mentioning it often, so I thought I might as well see what it was all about.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, I see...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<After following you, I had a look at your older posts, too.
Your illustrations are really amazing.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Like, there's a mood to them.
You know what I mean, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, I think so.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Right, I don't know if you're just trying to be nice or if you mean it, but thanks. Those pictures are nothing special, I draw stuff like that all the time.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Enanan, I checked the illustrations you sent.
It's all good, let's use them.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You sure? The lighting's fine the way it is?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I was thinking that maybe it was too bright, or the contrast was too high...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It seemed fine to me, but if you want to make any changes, I don't mind either.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! I can't wait to see the final result!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can't get my illustrations to trend, but at least these guys view them.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (They're actually interested in my art...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sure. It'll knock your socks off when I'm done!>
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... I can't seem to make it better...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
This design needs to look cuter...
Maybe like this?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... This just looks like I'm just lying down...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I know! I'll put these two on both sides and take the picture from a higher angl—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ahh!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: For goodness' sake! What do you want?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What do you mean, what do I want?
I've been calling you to come down for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? It's already dinner time?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why'd you think I've been knocking on your door for so long? Hurry up or you're going to have to skip dinner.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
O-Okay already.
But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What about him?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
He's not here.
Probably still in his studio.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then I'll go.

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I can't believe this!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Can't believe what, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<You have to listen to this!
Okay, so the fish that was served during dinner tasted different than usual.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Okay.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <So I told my mom about it, right?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <She said she used another brand of mirin sauce because she ran out of the usual one.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Mirin sauce?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<That's amazing, Enanan.
I wouldn't be able to tell the difference between sauces from different brands.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Me neither.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <How were they different?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <It tasted different, and the marinade was a little off. Anyway, that part was actually acceptable.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <The biggest problem was what my mom said after that. Guess what she said?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <No idea...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <She said, You're just like your father in that aspect!>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I can't believe she said I was like that man!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Ah... Right.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <And that's why I—>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Alright, let's not talk about this anymore.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Oh, sorry for venting like that...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<It's okay.
I wasn't bothered about it at all.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <The more important thing here is that Enanan's progress is the slowest. It's not just the illustrations. You haven't recorded your part of the song yet, have you?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yes... But I'll be sure to submit everything on time.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Can you make it?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yes, I'll try to get everything done by tonight!>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Alright. But I don't want the quality of your work to drop because you were rushing.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Especially the illustrations.
So only upload work that you're satisfied with.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <K... Yes, you got it!>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: (Unlike that man, K recognizes my art...)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: I'll upload illustrations that are so out of this world, even K can't help but be amazed by them!
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, I have to go now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <To school? That's a lot earlier than usual.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yes. I'll be dropping by somewhere else along the way.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. See you later, then.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yup. See you later!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright!
Today is the day I record my best vocals ever!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Karaoke Shop Staff
rows.Line: Thank you for visiting!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sigh... I didn't hit the high notes very well, as usual.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If my singing voice could be clearer, it would harmonize so much better with the others...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe I shouldn't have given up so quickly...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm back. K, do you have a minute?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, what is it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I recorded my singing part today and...
I was wondering if you could give it a listen?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Send it over.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thanks.
Here it comes.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I got it.
Give me a while to listen to it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Enanan, you've been working really hard lately.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What? Does it seem that way?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<It totally does!
I was just thinking about the same thing myself, actually.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That wasn't my intention at all, though...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Working hard, huh.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (To me it feels more like I'm panicking than working hard.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(K and Yuki are both amazing.
Amia seems frivolous but is actually quite mature.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And that makes me feel so...helpless.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Huh? A notification?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (You have new followers...huh.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Now the gap with my illustration account is even larger...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Everything I do is lackluster...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Enanan, are you there?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Ah, yes. I'm here.
How was my singing?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Much better than I expected.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?! Do you mean that?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. But your voice disappeared at some parts with the higher notes.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I thought you might notice that...
And I practiced for it, too...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, that's why your voice sounded fuller than before. I think you have the potential to do even better.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thank you...
I guess I'll try a little harder, then.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Also, I saw the illustration draft you sent yesterday.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I have nothing much to add to that either.
I look forward to seeing it completed.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You did great, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Yes...
I may be lackluster, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Right now, someone's looking at me properly.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You can count on me. I'll make sure it's the best one yet!
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ngh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The coloring makes this illustration look filthy.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now look here! I deliberately chose that color theme because the picture's supposed to portray a messy sort of atmosphere!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Oh. I couldn't tell.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <This line here is crooked and it bothers me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I did that on purpose too!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Oh. I couldn't tell.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ohh, it makes me so mad that she couldn't understand the part I spent so much time on!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it's not like K or Amia said anything about it, so it doesn't matter if Yuki doesn't understand...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's directly connected to the image of the song, though. Guess it wouldn't hurt to touch it up a little more.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, K!
Can you take a closer look at the last part of the music video for me?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I completely overhauled it from the initial draft.
I think it's more melancholic this way!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's nice.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <All right! I'll continue on in this direction, then♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, why's everyone so quiet on Nightcord today?
What's up, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hello? You there? Are you muted or something?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She's online. Maybe she's just focusing on something.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Man, I feel so restless when she's all quiet like this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But she'll just yell at me to shut up if I talk too much, so I'm gonna concentrate on finishing the MV too!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <All done!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa! You gave me a fright! What happened, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Stop overreacting, Amia.
I just finished touching up the illustration, that's all.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, the one Yuki was criticizing you about the other day?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Don't remind me!
Just thinking about that makes me so angry!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But you were touching up the picture because her comments upset you, right? You really hate to fail, after all.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, shut up!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yuki, I just sent the file over on Nightcord. Take a look.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wow. It feels completely different now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's still basically the same thing, but I adjusted the color combination meant to convey the messy feelings to better express the idea.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Jealousy and hatred may both be negative feelings, but they're still not the same thing, right? So I tried to differentiate them too.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's filthy.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Excuse me?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I understand you're trying to convey the messiness of two feelings clashing together.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The lines are crooked, but they're not distracting.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmph! I'm glad you see that now.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But it's still somewhat off-balance on the whole.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's supposed to express the instability of someone almost about to burst from holding in these feelings that are making them lose their power of reason!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Argh! Why can't I seem to convey this nuance correctly?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <There, there. I thought it was easier to tell than before!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What was the point of me touching up the illustration if Yuki doesn't understand?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And Enanan's tough exterior strikes again!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sorry?! What's that got to do with this?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hehe...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <See, even K's laughing.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Um, K? That wasn't supposed to be funny.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry. It's just...you seem to be having so much fun.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha! I know what you mean!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You were seriously mad with Yuki just a while ago, remember?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, you're still mad with her about something now, but it feels like you're having fun about it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I-I'm not having fun at all!>
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey everyone!
There's an exhibition coming up next Saturday!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's about life in medieval Europe, and some of the clothes people wore during that era will be on display!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Let's all go together to find some inspiration for our next song!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The medieval era...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You just want to see the clothes, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oops, you figured it out?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It was so blatant. Were you even trying to hide it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <An exhibition, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There you are! Whoa! What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Come on, let's all go together!
What about you, Yuki? You interested?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm going out with my mother on that day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, then it can't be helped, I guess. What a shame.>
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I have to go to bed now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Me too. I'm logging off for today.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay. Good night, you two!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're not sleeping yet, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I'll stay awake for a bit more.
I wouldn't want you to feel lonely, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What's that supposed to mean?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <By the way...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hm? Something the matter?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You don't have to try so hard to invite her to outings and events, you know.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's just going to make things worse if the doll exhibition thing happens again.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, really...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wh-What?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Nothing? You must be really worried about Yuki, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Huh? Stop jumping to conclusions.
It's not like that.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's just... I was surprised to see her that way.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah... Me too.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You see? So if we go out somewhere together and she becomes like that again...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, maybe if you view it as some form of shock therapy? Then it wouldn't bother you so much, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Shock therapy?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But what if the shock is too much for her to take and she starts thinking about disappearing again?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<That would hurt K badly, wouldn't it?
She's trying so hard to help Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
That's why we need to have that determination too.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Determination for?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The same determination K showed Yuki before.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The determination to save her and never leave her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <This is probably what it means to get involved with someone else's life, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's easier said than done, though...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, we're all still in the process of trying to find the best way to face each other, after all. K to Yuki, and Yuki to herself.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So you don't have to think too deeply into this, Enanan. Honestly, it's not as if I completely understand, either.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I wish I could be as laidback as you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I think I get what you mean.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So thanks, Amia.>
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A New Year's Countdown Party, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's simple! Let's do it in SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! We can meet up without having to go outside and we'll get to party together with Miku!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I can take care of organizing it all...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: At least it won't be cold in SEKAI and I won't have to see anyone I don't want to. It's not a bad idea, actually.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But there's still so much time to kill before evening...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Also... Mizuki volunteered to take care of everything, but it wouldn't feel right for me just to turn up empty-handed...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I know. I'll bring some of the sweets we got as year-end gifts. Hehe. I can sample a few first too.
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
He's... Not here? Mom's not here either.
Maybe they went shopping?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, whatever....
The gifts should all be in the living room...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, it's you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What are you doing with the gifts, Akito?
And what are you munching on...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Mom asked me to divvy them up while she was out shopping. And this is what I was eating...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, those look yummy! Cute colors too! Where are they from? Hmm... This logo looks familiar, but what was it from...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I could be wrong, but I think it's that new place run by that famous patisserie chain and specializes in madeleines. They're pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But mom asked you to go through them, right? Not to eat them all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She didn't say anything about not eating them, so why not? Hmm... I guess the vanilla ones were the best after all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you trying to turn me into your accomplice...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't care either way, but didn't you come out of your room to pinch some of the sweets anyway?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, so what if I did...?
Also, I need some to take with me tonight.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You going somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. My group's meeting up for a New Year's Countdown Party. What flavor are the green ones?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Green tea. They're decent.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm. I bet they'd go well with black tea. I'll put on a kettle.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Cool, make me some too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come on, it's no effort. Just put more water in the kettle so there's enough for me too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll make you tea if you bring the gifts over to my room.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There. That's all of them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Whoa, we got a lot this year.
Opening them one by one's gonna be a pain.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right? But picking out a few to eat in the meantime makes it less tedious.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, can't you open them a little nicer?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You wanna spend the whole day carefully opening each gift? Oh, bummer... This one's just seaweed.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... You're so uncultured. Pass me that blue box.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks. I bet there's some sort of fruit in this one... Hah, I was right! It's compote!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, yokan jelly...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: W-Will you stop ripping them open like that? You're just adding to the trash pile!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Like there'd be any less if you folded them neatly. And this one's... Ham.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That needs to be refrigerated. The other box at the bottom looks to be meat too. Can you put them both in the fridge?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's in here... Black tea. And judging from its wrapper, it's yokan jelly again.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I got Castella cake.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are they pre-cut?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's a whole one. It's mom's favorite too, so we probably shouldn't touch it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah...
What's in that long box?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This one? Let's see...
Juice. Apple and grape.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, it's from that famous fruit parlor.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Mizuki's bringing some snacks so...
I could take this juice.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can you put those two bottles aside for me? I'll need a bag for them too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're taking both?
They're glass, and pretty heavy...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll be fine. I'm not going very far.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, and can you tell Mom that I won't need any New Year's soba too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, sure...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I'm going back to my room.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? We're not done checking the gifts.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mom asked you to take care of that, not me. Have fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: H-Hey!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine... But don't count on me leaving you any of the best stuff!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Phew... There. Two bottles of juice should be more than enough for the four of us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we're really spending New Year's Eve together...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So much has happened this year...
The thing with Mafuyu, and us discovering SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You know, it was a surprisingly good year...
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yawn... I'm so sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Same... Yaaawn!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But you actually managed to get up early.
I mean, it's only 7...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I can get up early if I have to.
I set my alarm's volume to max.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The truth is, I only woke up because Akito stormed into my room, snatched the blankets and told me to turn my alarm off...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, you turned down my invite to hang out just because it was cold, but you're dragging me along shopping today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You could've said no. Besides, if we had to wait in a line outside, I wouldn't have come either.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you line up indoors for this, and the stores I want to go to are all conveniently located near each other.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmph. So you come here for the New Year's sales every year?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Line: By the way, we need to come up with a plan.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You mean, plan out which stores to go to?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I want the grab bags from this store and the ones on the second floor. As much as I want to check out accessories and stuff, the cosmetics grab bags are my top priority.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to see a few apparel shops on the second floor too, so we can go together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No accessories?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. It's not that I'm not interested, but it's no biggie. I could definitely use more cosmetics, so I'm going for those too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay. We still need to think about where each of us has to go after this one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. We gotta be efficient to get everything we want before it's all gone♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, hey. They should be opening soon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're right. Time really flies when you're strategizing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Everyone waiting looks so excited too.
I'm starting to get pretty excited!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience!
We are now starting our grab bag sales!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Finally!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Got our first one♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cool! I'll go to the next place on our list!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay! Let me know if anything happens!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
The third store on our list is...
Here! The one Mizuki wanted!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Great, they still have their white outfit sets too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, got it. Next is...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? A message? Maybe it's from Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <They're running out of everything M-sized at the store you like!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way! They didn't sell this fast last year!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Forget the cosmetics! See if you can still get anything in M for me!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You got it♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mizuki, you're my only hope.
Alright, next for me is...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki...! I'm over here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Looks like we got everything we wanted!
Now, let's check out the spoils♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hold on. This is an M bag, right?
Why is there L-sized stuff mixed in...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha. Bummer!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This isn't funny! Ugh... That store's too far to go bother asking for an exchange...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why don't you give the ones that are too big for you to Mafuyu? They'd suit her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're right... But do you think she'd want them?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Who knows? Dang, this white dress would look better on Miku than me.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No. The color's all wrong...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The clouds covering up the sky need to stand out more...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And the sky needs to feel close but still unreachable. The rays of light should also be more transparent, but feel warm and bright...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At this rate, I'll never be able to capture the melody Kanade came up with...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know what I want to draw, but I can't...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A genius wouldn't have to stop and think about every step they take. They'd just find a way and finish...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... No, I don't have time to think about that!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it just isn't right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Why? The more I draw, the further I get away from what I envisioned...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sigh... And Kanade's song went like...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? This melody seemed fine at first...

rows.Speaker: Ena

rows.Line: <Okay...>

rows.Line: (Ah, there we go...)

rows.Line: (Wait... These haven't been edited yet? And they're this good already? What's there to fix?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Yuki got this much done while I was running around in circles...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is what it means to be a genius...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No... Talent or being a genius doesn't matter anymore...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just don't give up. I have to keep drawing, period...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No...! I left my mic on...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I, um... About that... I was just talking to myself, so...>

rows.Line: <I see.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Um, well...>

rows.Line: (Thank goodness... Plus, it's just Mafuyu and she doesn't care about...)

rows.Line: <You really love art, don't you...?>

rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Line: <That's nice...>

rows.Line: It doesn't matter whether or not my songs are any good.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What I want isn't great songs, nor is it the praise of others. All I wanted was to find what I was looking for.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mafuyu! Whoa! What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Right... Even Mafuyu carries a certain kind of pain that only she can understand...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And it has been kept at arm's length for now thanks to Kanade...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And Kanade... Even Mizuki... They also carry that pain.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And I'm no different. I fell into that same trap...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that you don't have any talent, Ena, but I don't think so...

rows.Line: And I don't believe that you're the kind of person that needs recognition in order to draw, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If no one acknowledged or recognizes you now, just keep drawing until someone does.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We have to keep creating what we do anyway so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And I'll keep on making music with them. As long as I can...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yuki...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Can you look at my rough draft later?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Me? Not K?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'll show K too. Amia will find some way to peek at it and poke holes in it so...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I thought you should see it too, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'll try to get it done today, so you can see it. In the meantime, I'll be muting everything so I can focus on it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay. I'll do the same.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I'll show her. I'll make something that'll surprise even Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And, oh... If Mafuyu has no interest to speak of...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll just make it so my art fills that hole!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Time to get started!

rows.Line: Hmm... Which bag should I take?

rows.Line: This one would probably be the most useful since it has so many pockets, but it doesn't have a spring vibe to it.

rows.Line: It's on the small side, but this one's a nice, spring-like color. Now, what clothes match this...?

rows.Line: Oh, yeah... Coming!

rows.Line: Hehe. If you like it, Ena, I'm sure your father will too.

rows.Line: That reminds me... You're going somewhere with Akiyama, right?

rows.Line: Like a vacation?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, yeah. My friends and I are going on a little trip during the next holiday.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But one girl almost never goes outside, so we made it a day trip for her sake. It sounds like it's going to be fun.

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: Okay, but just be careful, and play nice with your friends.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mom, I'm not a little kid anymore.

rows.Line: Oh, Akiyama also reminded me to wake you up if you try to sleep in on the day of.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Why would I let it go to waste by doing something like that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Says you. Remember what you made me do every time New Year's rolled around?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, you're still mad about that?
Get over it already, will you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? You made me wake up at 5 am on New Year's Day every year until now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I was finally released from being your personal mule this year.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So? It couldn't have been all that bad.

rows.Line: When I pulled you out of your bed!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I see. At least things haven't gotten worse, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I have a feeling that this is gonna take a pretty long time to work out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki has this knack for dodging questions and avoiding people.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I got that. I tried to get a conversation going during the Green Adventure...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But every time I thought I had a chance to actually go for it and ask, I sort of wasn't able to commit or get any good answers...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: See what I mean? It's like this is turning into a never-ending staring contest.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'll make Mizuki regret not telling me sooner.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. And I don't expect you to give up anytime soon!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I just want to move past this already.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know what made Mizuki feel that way...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What am I supposed to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even if this song isn't able to save you, I'll keep composing until I find the one that does.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll keep composing...until you can find yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I need that sort of resolve...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Kanade showed Mafuyu how determined she is...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have to do the same...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I sort of just clammed up there, didn't I? Wait, why are you grinning like that...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just glad that you're back to your old self.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My old self?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. My favorite part about you is how you can just say or do what's on your mind without a second thought.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not sure if that's a compliment or an insult...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course it's a compliment!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It might not sound all that great coming from me, but I really do admire that part of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So do what you can for Mizuki, okay? Shizuku and I will help however we can too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right! Thanks, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And look at that. Our parfaits are finally here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, they're even better than what we saw in the pictures. Okay, which angle works best...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mind giving me a few tips on how to take good pics? It's sort of been a while since we last did this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. No problem!
For something like this, it might be best to...
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, this intro's awesome...!
I love this vibe.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it really tells you what's going on from the start.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh... Kanade's wondering how Mafuyu feels about it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Kanade...)
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you for today, everyone. I'd like to focus a little more, so I'll be logging off now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay, I'll do that too♪
Later, Yuki, Enanan...!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Bye.
I'll be going too, Enanan...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wait, Yuki.
There's something I want to talk to you about...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Isn't there something else that you should tell K?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You can at least tell just how hard she's been working on this song, right? How hard she's been working just for you...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So I should thank her or tell her that I appreciate what she's doing?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah... But...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I won't understand unless you tell me...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I already would be if I could.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But that's also on you, no?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Having us spell everything out for you means that you have no intention of thinking for yourself, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I know that you've learned to feel at least something, so try to figure out what that is, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I see... I apologize...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm not mad or anything, okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm just frustrated...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You are?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I don't really have a hand in the actual music behind our songs...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But you're different. You know how to make really amazing songs.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yet you hardly ever say anything or think about what you're doing. That's what's so frustrating...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm even spelling out why I'm such a pathetic human being, aren't I?! Ugh... It's not fair...!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I have nothing to do with that last part.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Shut up!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Enanan...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <This might make you even angrier but...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Leading with that isn't helping...
What is it...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You're the only one that wears their heart on their sleeve like this, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <*Sigh*... Just try saying what's on your mind from now on, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <The way you talk is unbelievably irritating, but at the same time, you're almost never wrong.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I will get mad if you annoy me. Fair warning.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Is getting mad the same as getting angry?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's exactly what I'm talking about!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Ugh... I got what I needed to off my chest, so bye...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay, good night.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Night.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*... Why is Mafuyu always like that...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But at least we're sort of having more meaningful conversations now. She really has been changing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Plus, there's someone that's being even more of a bother right now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki's a talker but clams up every time anyone tries to make some headway...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Everything we say just gets dodged or avoided. In that sense, Mafuyu's a million times easier to deal with...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Why won't you tell me anything?
Can you not trust me?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*...
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I'll be logging off now.
Good night, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm glad Kanade's feeling better now.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which leaves us with...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (We haven't talked for a while...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to ask Mizuki a favor too, so... Okay!)
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, there we go. Morning.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Morning. You remembered to bring the clothes you wanted me to fix up, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, here. I bought it because the pattern on the fabric is really cute, but it just doesn't look right, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right. It is a really nice fabric, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... The sleeves are kind of long. It almost looks like menswear.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's too wide between the shoulders too. No wonder it doesn't fit you. I see what you mean by it not looking quite right.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You think so too? I went for it since it seemed to fit alright at first glance...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But size depends on who makes it too♪
Alright... Let's go!
Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And here's the final design!
First, I'll trim away the parts around the shoulders that make it look too big on you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then I'll use that fabric to spice it up and turn it into a halter top!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Finally, I'll give the bust area some gather for a better looking silhouette♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow... This looks so cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right? I'll go with this design then!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (To be honest, I was expecting Mizuki to reject my invitation. I'm surprised to have even gotten this far.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Maybe something good happened?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh, right...
Mizuki mentioned something about bumping into Kanade. Maybe it's something she said...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ena, you mind...?
You've been staring at me for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, um... I was just wondering if you did your eyes differently today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay?
Sadly, no. It's not any different from what I usually do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Anyways, don't mind me.
Just focus on what you're doing, alright?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I already am. I feel like you're the one that's been coming and going, honestly.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't feel like I have...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But something's bothering you, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, you mentioned something about running into Kanade the other day, so I was wondering what you two talked about is all...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Geez... Mafuyu's smart and everything, but Mizuki's just so sharp...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Uh... Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You bringing up Kanade made me remember just how amazing she really is, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Don't tell me that you're just realizing that now?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. No, I already knew.
I was just reminded of that is all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like how she wants to save her dad, Mafuyu and so many other people. She just puts her head down and keeps marching on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Even while knowing just how hard all of that is gonna be...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Giving up probably isn't an option for her. It's also probably why she was able to make Mafuyu smile the way she did.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm starting to think that Kanade might actually find a way to save her...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I hope she does...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But why are you bringing this up now...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Because you brought her up first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yes, really♪
Kanade's living such an incredible life too. Compared to her, my life's been so dull and boring.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I get in line like a law-abiding citizen when limited edition goods that I'm after goes on sale.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And when all official options for getting tickets to an anime concert dry up, I give up like a good person.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? You gave up like a good person? Come to think of it, that concert you tried to go to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You applied three times through the priority, early and normal sale periods, right? I even let you use my email address.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You got so desperate that you waited for them to announce ticket sales for the day of on their website.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? It's all a bit fuzzy now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You wouldn't stop complaining either.
How can anyone forget that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You don't just give up... You're more stubborn than most people.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But in that regard, I'm in the same boat as you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Otherwise, I...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll try drawing something. I don't know if it'll be any good, but I'll try.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wouldn't have gone back to drawing if I weren't.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Once we've set our minds on something, we stop budging.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then you're just like Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Why just me?
You're the same too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, enough chatting.
Just a bit more to go and I'll be done♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't wait to see it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I guess Mizuki is feeling a little better...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I didn't learn anything new, but I guess I should just wait patiently for now...)
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Why do I have to go...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, stop being such a baby. I'm not the only one getting pancakes, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: On top of that, you haven't properly thanked me yet for getting your shoes back, so you'll be paying for me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, this place we're going to today is doing its grand opening or something, so we get a discount on toppings if we go as three or more.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh... It's a new store that I probably would've ended up going to anyway, so I'll let this one slide.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, don't give me that look. You weren't exactly my first choice in terms of who to take either, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was actually hoping to go with Kanade, Airi and Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But Kanade's busy with our next song, and Airi's busy making new videos with her group, so maybe next time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was even thinking about inviting Mafuyu, but she's busy with cram school on weekends, so I ran out of options...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's why you get to treat me for rescuing your shoes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I know. You don't need to remind me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's try to enjoy ourselves. Especially since delicious pancakes are awaiting us♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you're really old fashioned about returning favors, huh, Li'l Bro?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If I don't, it'll definitely come back to bite me in the butt.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you're one to talk. Why'd you decide to come along?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because I was bored, and I felt bad about how everyone else flaked on Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I also thought it'd be fun since she said that YOU'D be here too, Li'l Bro!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Seriously...?
But I guess it's not like you were dragged out here by her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Lately, it feels like Ena's been worried and trying to do stuff for me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, what are you two talking about?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? About you behind your back...

rows.Speaker: Ena & Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena? Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Mafuyu!
Are you on your way to cram school?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hello, Ena, Mizuki.
And... Ena's brother?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Nice to meet you. My name is Mafuyu Asahina. I've been hanging out quite a lot with Ena lately.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you too.
I'm Akito Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Are you from her group too?
I hope things are going well between all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yikes... Polite Mafuyu gives off this really weird vibe, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess she has to act that way since she's never met Li'l Bro before. We haven't seen her flip that switch in a while, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (After what happened with her, Miku and SEKAI, she's been herself ever since and just spouting whatever comes to mind.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But that probably means it's less stress for her, so I guess that's a good thing...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, maybe we should move off to the side to talk? Someone with a giant dog is coming right this way.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Li'l Bro?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm fine. Don't worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry. We didn't mean to block your path.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
No, I apologize too.
He's just gotten so big...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, a golden retriever.
Hello.

rows.Speaker: Dog
rows.Line: *Sniff*... *Whimper*...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, I guess he doesn't like being touched.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: That's strange. He usually loves meeting other people and wags his tail to show it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess animals can pick up on it immediately. It's like they know something's wrong...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: If you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I need to go soon as well.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yup, alright. See you on Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, wait...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry about that. This is just how she is, so if you'll just understand...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Now, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Laters.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you mean, This is how she is?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: For your information, I've been doing a ton for Mafuyu and tiptoeing around all of her problems.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh, you...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Relax, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Li'l Bro just doesn't know what Mafuyu's really like.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know, but...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And we have delicious pancakes waiting for us up ahead, so let's get going♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you're not going anywhere, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I know.
Also, we needed to take a left back there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Shut up. I knew that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You liar!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha!
Mafuyu's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <How is it, K...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<There, all done...
Now we just have to upload it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Finally, we can relax now!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. Thanks, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Nice work with this, everyone.
And sorry about asking all of you to make last-minute adjustments in the end...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's okay. If it helps make your song more complete, K, I don't mind.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Do you always have to be so blunt? A little tact goes a long way, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And there's no need for you to be apologizing either, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'm doing this because I truly think it's fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, Enanan, Amia, you went to that pancake place yesterday, right? How was it? Were you able to make it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, but we decided to go later in the day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And the pancakes were sooo good! Enanan's Li'l Bro was all twisted in knots about being forced to go, but he really liked it too!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, didn't you say that you get a discount for going as three or more? So Enanan's younger brother was your third?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yes. Oh, I almost forgot!
We even ran into Yuki along the way.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Wait, you did?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. I was on my way to cram school, and I ended up talking to Enanan's little brother some...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I was surprised by how different he is compared to her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <He was just putting on a face for you. He's actually this arrogant and rude little brat!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I see.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (You were doing the exact same things as him.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I guess neither of them could've done anything about that...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Also, Yuki, do animals not like you or something? That dog we ran into seemed really scared of you for some reason.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, it was...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't know. I've had dogs bark at me before, while cats and birds don't come near me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I think we have our answer...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That dog's reaction reminded me of Otori.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Otori? Who's that again?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She goes to the same school as Yuki, but one year younger. They were partners for the three-legged race during their Sports Festival, remember?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, her. She sings and skips through the courtyard often, and has even jumped off the second floor to the courtyard. She also greets people by saying, Wonderhoy!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, and she's in high school?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She must have so much energy...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've heard that Miya Girls has a lot of students working in show business, so it's a little weird to hear that someone like that goes there too.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, speaking of being scared, Enanan, do you and Li'l Bro not like dogs or something?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <When that dog tried to get closer to you two, you both tried to use me as a shield.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's not like that at all... It's just, big breeds aren't really my thing...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, but Akito pretty much dislikes all dogs regardless of size.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, really?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <When he was little, he got bit by one...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It happened when... Oh, Akito, our mom and I went to the park for a little picnic...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <The owner of this one dog accidently let go of its leash, and it just came charging towards us...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I tripped and fell while running away from it. Mom came to help me, but that left Akito wide open, and he ran for it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I'm guessing it chased after him then...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Exactly. It just nibbled on him a little, so it wasn't anything serious.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wow. So that's how I ended up being a human shield for you guys?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Again, it wasn't like that. We were blocking their path, and I moved you out of the way.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: <Oh, are you sure?>

rows.Speaker: Ena

rows.Line:
...

rows.Line: What is the temperature of the water in this picture?

rows.Line: Huh? Its...temperature?

rows.Line: Um... It's not cold. I think it's a little warm to the touch...

rows.Line: Very well. And in what direction is it flowing?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Flowing... Actually, rather than flowing, I think it's just sort of wavering in place...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Do you mean to say that this is a body of water with no obvious current, such as a lake or spring?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, yes. I think so.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I see. You said that you took on this piece as a way of working on your depiction of water, no?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, that's correct.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Well then, let me begin from that perspective. This piece does not provide enough information for the imagination.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do you mean about things like the temperature and current?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Yes. Texture is, of course, an important aspect of a piece. However...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: A crucial part of refining your technique is how you visually convey to the viewer that which, usually, can only be understood by direct contact.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I guess I neglected that aspect by fixating too much on the texture of the water...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: With that said, even if you had succeeded in that regard, I would not think this a good piece.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: In the end, this is merely “a sketch of a person swimming”. In itself, it has no meaning or value.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Value I can understand, but surely this had some meaning as a practice piece?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: The question of “how” one creates art begins with “what” one wishes to express with it.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: When the artist knows what they want to express, and then accomplishes this with rich use of composition and techniques that are appropriate or perhaps even innovative...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: That is what I believe to be good art.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: If you reattempt this exercise, I look forward to seeing your own original work. Not a reproduction.

rows.Line: <I'm back...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, and I had a much clearer picture in my head as to what I was gonna draw compared to normal...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <See! That's what I mean!>

rows.Line: <So, along with all of N25's followers, I think Yuki's gonna really like what we made!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But her being her...

Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yuki still isn't here...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, and she hasn't said anything...

rows.Line:

Ena...?

Yeah, I think you get the picture.

<...na.
Ena.>
