rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Fortunately, it sounded like K was the one talking to Yuki's mom, so we have nothing to worry about there...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But we shouldn't let our guard down.
Who knows what that woman's gonna do next?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, has K told you the rest of that story yet?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, what do you mean?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Apparently Yuki's mom went over to K's house yesterday.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, but she made sure to call K in advance, though!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<She did?!
Geez... So, how'd that go...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yuki apparently repeated over and over that she didn't want to go home.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Which is why she's staying over at K's place now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mafuyu actually told her mom that she didn't want to go home.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thank goodness.
You're both here already.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, K!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <How's Yuki doing?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She's sitting right next to me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What is it, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, Yuki...! You feeling a little better now?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Seems like a lot has happened recently. Are you holding up okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, I'm fine now...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Working seems to help take her mind off of things. I know it's a little early, but I had her start already.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Right!
Now that she's at your house, K, that means she can actually join us at 25:00!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, wait a second. Do you have any other clothes to change into, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She's wearing some of my sweats for now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<She is?
But you and Yuki aren't really the same size...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, they're probably a little tight on her...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's okay. They are a little small, but they'll do.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That reminds me of how you complained about my pajamas being too small when you stayed over at my house.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, settle down. Don't go biting her head off♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, aren't you gonna need a lot of stuff if you plan on staying for an extended period?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, since you can't really share toothbrushes or underwear and stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Enanan's right. We should try getting what you need.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, if it's about money, don't worry. I can chip in a little.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I can't let you do that.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, why not just call it a gift...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It'd be a lot easier to accept as opposed to receiving cash straight up, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, nice idea!
We've got tons of spare toothbrushes at my house!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And I'm pretty sure we have a lot of extra pajamas stashed away somewhere.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Little stuff like that should help hold you over for at least a little while, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Thank you...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright, I'll try looking for anything you can use.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'll also try looking for some stuff that I can give you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you both very much.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We can bring them over the next time we gather at the diner.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Sorry, and thank you...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<It's the least we can do.
For now, just try to get your life and feelings back in order, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness for Kanade...
Mafuyu doesn't seem to be feeling as down as when she came over to my house.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It doesn't have to be immediate, but I hope she starts feeling better soon.)
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Mhm... I slept great...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, it's still morning...?!
I thought I went to sleep around dawn.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was only asleep for four hours?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm going back to sleep...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I'm fully awake now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I should just get up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Since I managed to wake up early for a change, I should practice drawing something...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But what...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What if it's because your sketch has some sort of special place in Mafuyu's heart?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This lake was born out of Mafuyu's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Seeing your sketch may've had some sort of effect on her. That might be why you're seeing it floating around now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My sketch had an effect on her...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My sketch had a real effect on her...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I can draw something like that again...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(That's it...!
Instead of just Mafuyu, I should try drawing everyone in N25 today.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Where'd that video of all of us go...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, this...! When we went to PXL together!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It turned out really well.
And the angle's perfect!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, wait, I need to keep looking...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, this one's from... The time we went on that mystery tour.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We saw those cherry blossoms together and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They were so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'll try drawing something based on this.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wonder what was going through everyone's mind that day...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh yeah, Mizuki tried to surprise us by hiding the fact that the place we were going to was supposedly haunted.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Always trying to mess with people...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki also suggested that we take this picture together, so... Okay, I'll go with it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, I think Mizuki turned out pretty good.
Next is Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (How was Kanade behaving this day?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, right. She was petrified over the thought of going somewhere that was haunted.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But Mafuyu dragged her through that tunnel believing it'd inspire her to compose more songs...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Also, I didn't know at the time how big a scaredy cat Kanade was.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Next, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She disappeared for a minute when we went to that abandoned school. We tried looking for her and ended up discovering that cherry blossom tree in full bloom...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And we talked about a bunch of stuff while standing in front of it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Despite everything that happened throughout the day, we all seemed to feel the same while looking at those cherry blossoms...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But what were we feeling? How do I describe that in words?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I guess a visual representation would look something like...this? No, that doesn't seem right at all...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh...
I don't know how to put that feeling into words or art!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I need to dig deeper and find a way to really express what we felt...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Mizuki seemed a bit conflicted back then.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wonder... Is Mizuki still...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I promised that I'd wait!
For now, focus on drawing!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I've got the general composition down...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... But is this drawing really gonna have an effect on the others?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What if I did something like this...?
No, that doesn't feel right... Okay, how about...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I can't figure it out...
And I feel like it's starting to lose its initial meaning...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Argh! It's so hard to illustrate how all four of us are feeling all at once!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I should start over...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Ena, are you asleep? I'm coming in.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Mom...?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you're awake.
You need to get ready for school or you're going to be late.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it's still before noon... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mom, why didn't you tell me sooner?!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I tried multiple times.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, were you drawing something just now? You must've been really focused on it...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Lately, you've been showing how that part of your father is also—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, nothing.
Anyway, would you like something to eat before you go?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I am hungry, but I'm gonna be late if I don't go now...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Then, take some of the rice balls I left in the kitchen.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I can have them before class! Thanks, Mom!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Morning.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Good morning, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena, you actually woke up on time? Oh, I get it! You had your Li'l Bro wake you, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I woke up on my own thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Besides, I've got everyone's tickets, so I had to be on time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You said you got the tickets for the satellite Puroland from Momoi?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. She said, “They gave me these 'cos I'll be appearing in an event. You want 'em?”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's still amazing though. I heard they were standing in for someone, but sharing the stage with My Melody is a whole other level!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe, well for idols as talented as Airi and the others it's only natural. They're performing today too, so we definitely need to go watch.
Satellite Puroland

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's bigger than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. Apparently there's a number of attractions from the actual Sanrio Puroland we can experience here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Some of the fine details of the interior look a bit different, but the atmosphere and the attractions seem fairly close to the original.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow...
Ooh! There's a boat attraction! Let's ride that one!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hang on a sec! Are we gonna get soaked on that thing?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The sign doesn't mention anything about that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So it's fine then! Come on, let's line up♪

rows.Speaker: Puroland Staff Member
rows.Line: Welcome to the Sanrio Character Boat Ride! The wait time is currently 30 minutes.

rows.Speaker: Puroland Staff Member
rows.Line: If you would like, please feel free to enjoy our app while you wait.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: “Satellite Park Exclusive Free Coloring App”?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: “Help Hello Kitty, My Melody and their Puroland friends look cute by coloring in these pictures!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That looks fun! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, we do have 30 minutes we need to kill anyway. Okay, so I just scan this code, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I'll try it out as well. What about you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I will too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmmm, now who should I color? They're all so cute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How 'bout Kuromi? You both kind of have the same vibe.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Look, if you tap on the top right of the page you have open, you can see that character's profile.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really? Okay, where is...
Oh! Here's Kuromi.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: “Kuromi is the self-proclaimed rival of My Melody. Although she may look tough, she is actually very girly and is attracted to good-looking guys!”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, hang on. What makes you think she and I are alike?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Just a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I mean, if I had to pinpoint it...
You're a little prickly on the outside, but you're actually really considerate and care a lot about your friends. Or something like that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Who do you think you're calling prickly?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh-oh, did I strike a nerve?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oww! Kanade, Mafuyu, you saw that, right?! She hit me!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmhmhm♪ Lalala♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The eyelashes seem pretty integral to the design of her eyes. And then I want the mouth to look confident...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh, I wish I could use layers! And I wish the pen were finer...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ah! I used the fill tool by mistake. Uh, how do I make it go back?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The Undo button in the lower left corner.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, my finger was covering it. Thanks, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Done.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ooh that was fast! Lemme see lemme see!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That one's...
Cogimyun? You only colored her hair accessories.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's because the rest of her is white.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, sure, but...
What about the background, or adding some items or other accessories? There's so much space for you to draw things in.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I thought there seemed like a lot of white space. That must be what they want you to use it for.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just colored inside the lines...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, the one you're coloring is so cute, Kanade! Is that a blanket on its head?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I think so. His name is...
Moppu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see! The soft colors you used on the polka-dot blanket look great.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You think so? Maybe because I tried to pick colors similar to the original.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, check mine out♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ta-daaa! Say hello to Bonbonribbon♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's a lot of ribbons.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's what makes it cute! Here, look! I added lace to the ribbon on her head♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?! That wasn't part of it originally? Wait, did you use some effect to draw that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Bingo♪ It's part of the app, so I tried it out. Makes it look extra fancy and cute, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Nice job.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How is yours coming, Ena? You were coloring Kuromi, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm mostly finished, but...
I figure I might as well draw in a little something extra.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here. This is what I've got so far.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Amazing... There are shadows and shading.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! That is way beyond coloring book level. Can't believe you made that on an app with such simple features.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That reminds me. She was also complaining about the lack of a layering feature and the thickness of the pen in the middle of it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You didn't have to put it like that. All I said was it'd be nice if they had it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think it looks great, but you're still going to work on it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. We still have to wait in line for a bit longer anyway.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe I'll draw a background, and make it into a little scene. Oh, I should give her some clothes too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ooh, clothes would be great! I can help with the design if you want♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Great, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okie dokie!
Ooh! So how about something that fits with Kuromi's motif? Like her favorite food or something!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm? I think her favorite food was...
Pickled scallions?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? That seems a bit plain for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think it's great. I love that she's unapologetically herself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's good that she likes what she likes, but as far as motifs go, I mean it's gotta be the skull, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come on, everyone does that! Pickled scallions are more challenging♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Challenging, or absurd?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, maybe not as the main motif...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I think adding some here and there as accents could work, probably...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Interesting.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's go with that♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Just you wait, Kuromi! Ena's gonna make you some super cute clothes!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Quit playing around...
Come on, gimme some real ideas to work with.
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, I'm logging off now!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You're gonna work on that picture, right? Let me see it when you're done!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, okay. See you later.>

rows.Line: Okay! First let me transfer the image from my phone, and then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh! Now that I can use layers, maybe I'll redo the coloring.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The lines for the clothes are also a bit messy. I'll clean up the spots that are crooked and overlapping while I'm at it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I never get to draw just for fun like this. I feel so at ease.)

Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ngh...
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I finished my drawing and uploaded it to Nightcord...
And then...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe I accidentally pressed something on my phone as I was dozing off. I should head back—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
That light, it's just like befor—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ah! What the—?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You guys?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, what the heck was that? Wait...
Ena?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Where the heck is this?! All of this is way too bizarre for me to handle!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, my phone flashed and I suddenly found myself here...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Everyone, be quiet. Something is coming toward us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: L-Let's hide behind that thing over there!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: H-Hang on a sec, Mafuyu. What's coming toward us? Where is it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I couldn't see it very well...
But it's over there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
It's floating!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What the—?! What is that thing?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Shhh! Don't be so loud!
Hm? Somebody there?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Eep! L-Leave us alone!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Waaah!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Was that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, you! Aren't you...
Kuromi?

rows.Speaker: Ena & Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Aw what, you're just humans? Your shouting scared the heck out of me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Are you really...
Kuromi?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, this place we've all fallen into is a SEKAI formed from a fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Looks that way. That's what I heard from someone else though, so I'm not totally sure.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right. Well, we've got a general grasp on the situation now. Thanks, Ms. Kuromi.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Just Kuromi's fine! We don't gotta be so formal.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Then, great to meet you, Kuromi.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Great to meetcha, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh yeah! Ena, you should show her your drawing!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? You want me to show it to the real deal?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Hm? Whatcha talkin' about?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We went to Puroland today, and Ena colored in a picture of you.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Oh really? I trust you captured my beauty on the page?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, I never skimp when it comes to art.
Here.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line:
Let's see...
What the—?! What is this?!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: I'm in a fashion show modeling a super cool Lolita dress?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wow...
So this is how it turned out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Even though the original picture was just Kuromi herself.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Huh?! So these clothes and this background were...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All drawn by Ena. I just helped give ideas for the clothing design, and she put it all together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The original picture showed you looking confident, so I thought up some different scenarios to fit with it till I landed on this one.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Luh—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Luh?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Luuuuv it!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Ena, Mizuki! You guys are amazing!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well I have some experience drawing, and I am studying art.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But everyone else is just as impressive.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The four of us make original songs together and post them online. Kanade composes, Mafuyu makes the mix and lyrics and Mizuki does the video editing.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Songs?! You guys make music?! By yourselves?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Our group is called Nightcord at 25:00.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Whoa! You guys are just too cool!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: I like you guys! Feel free to hang out here as long as you want!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kuromi, did you not just arrive here, same as us?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Who cares about the details?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: More importantly, you guys seem like you've got a lot of interesting stories.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm so exhausted...
It's been a long time since I last moved a bunch of heavy paintings around.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I really had no idea...
I mean, he used to be an actual starving artist. Him.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No one ever told me...
But...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: That was when I finally realized...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I can't escape it.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I can't live without art in my life.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: He can't live without art in his life...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to keep drawing! I have to keep drawing! If I keep drawing, then even I could...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, look at me... I don't have anything...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No talent... Nothing... Not like you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll try drawing something. I don't know if it'll be any good, but I'll try.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(The same thing happened to me.
No matter how much pain I suffered as my art when unnoticed...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I couldn't give up on it.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Which is why...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm ready to commit now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can't go back on my word after telling him, too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll start by doing a sketch. Then, I'll get to work on my stuff for N25. There's still some time until 25:00, so I'll log in first and—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A message? From who...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki...?
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena, over here!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You were already here, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I did ask you to pop over.
Plus, I have a feeling you'd get mad if I made you wait.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Why would I get mad?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, why'd you want to meet here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. There's actually something I wanna give you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Give me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! One sec...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
I got this cake just for you♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? A cake? Why...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You went over to help with your dad's exhibit today, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I decided to get you a present since I thought you deserved a little reward!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
A present...? Wait, hang on!
This is from that shop I said I wanted to go to the other day!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You went and got this just for me...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Not only that, but it's your favorite baked cheesecake!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What's more, I even brought you a fork.
So, bon appetit!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, wait. What's really going on here?
This is a little suspicious.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? What are you talking about?
All I'm trying to do is congratulate you on a job well done.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get that...
But I feel like you're going kinda overboard with this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Lemme guess. You're gonna want me to return the favor twofold later, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, is that how you view me?
If you don't want it, then I can take it back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I want it! I'll have it now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Something still feels off...
But I'm not about to say no to this since I've been wanting to try it forever.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, let's have a taste...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Great, enjoy♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mmm! So good...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's so rich with cheese...
The jam even adds a nice bit of sourness!
And it all goes perfectly with this crust...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No wonder everyone's been talking about it...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it so much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks.
*Sigh*
Why is it that sweets taste so good when you're tired?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Did you have a pretty long day...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It wasn't bad or anything...
But a lot did happen.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, it ended up being a good learning experience. Plus, it was the first time in a while that I looked at his paintings.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, all in all, I'm glad I went.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm glad for you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wait a second... Was Mizuki worried about me going to the exhibit...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is that what this cake is for...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I didn't realize just how much worry I caused...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks. For this cake, and everything else...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome...!
Ena's birthday
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm so tired from school...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was gonna work on my art assignment before dinner, but I think I'll take a break first and—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh, Rin? Why are you here all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <No reason. I just came to see you.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Also... I heard it's your birthday today.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... Did you come to say happy birthday to me? Thanks for going out of your way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's not exactly it... But, happy birthday, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, a message. Can you give me a second?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um... Oh, it's from Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line:
<Hellooo!
I know I told you already, but happy birthday, Ena!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <And to mark this very special day, get a load of this! You're getting a special movie created bespoke by me, Amia!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <With my exacting production standards, it's gonna be good enough to air on national TV. Enjoy♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: “Special movie”...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What happened?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, Mizuki just said, “Happy birthday,” and sent me a video.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What kind of video?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I haven't played it yet, but... Mizuki called it a “bespoke special movie”.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, while you're still here, do you want to watch it with me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is that okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a video made by Mizuki, so why not? Okay, I'm gonna hit play.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heya! Ena, are you watching?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Ahem! Production has now officially begun on this film commemorating Ms. Ena's birthday! A round of applause, please!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey! Would a little more enthusiasm kill you?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: <You got your applause, didn't you? From Toya, at least.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<You too Li'l Bro! Geez...
Anyway, these are my first two interviewees!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, I'll start by explaining our premise.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm asking my interviewees to tell me about their memories with Ena! I bet we're gonna hear some really surprising stories!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And so... Li'l Bro! Tell me a fond memory of your big sister that makes you all warm inside!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: <I don't have any.>

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: Excuse me? Like hell you don't. Be a bit more thoughtful, geez.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <In that case, could I offer an anecdote?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <I'm fond of claw machines, but sometimes I get carried away and win far too many plushies.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <But Ena is always willing to take them off me, which is such a help.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <So I'd like to take this opportunity to express my gratitude. Ena, thank you for always giving a home to the plushies I win.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Ooh, nice one Toya! Good with words as always. Unlike a certain little brother...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oops, better skedaddle before he gets mad at me. Thanks you two!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I've got a whole lot more people to interview! Let's go!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Now I'm here with our friends in Leo/need!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Um... Hello, Ena!
When it comes to memories I have with you, the first thing that comes to mind is when you taught me to draw.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <You were such a patient teacher, and you helped me learn to like art somewhat.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <And Hona's been drawing for us ever since!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <She seriously didn't enjoy it before then... We have you to thank, Shinonome.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Ena.
Oh, and... Let's exercise together again sometime.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Memories with Ena...?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Oh, so this one time, I was watching Ena sketch a pair of goldfish!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <She was super focused, and even though it was an incredible drawing, she still wasn't satisfied! I remember thinking how cool she was for setting such high standards.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Yeah, Ena's super serious and cool when she's making art. Unlike her usual self! What about you, Kohane?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Um, I competed with Ena in the Valentine's Day photo contest, and...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Her dedication to getting the best shot was so impressive! She and Airi were sprinkling petals, and...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Happy birthday Ena! Pop pop, poppity pop pop!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <To leave you smiling, I've prepared a song for today!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Huh?! Th-The plan was to ask you for an anecdote...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Oh, what the heck! At times like this you gotta go with the flow!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Alright, Emu! Take it away!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Okay☆ Start the music!!!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You have a lot of friends, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean... Most of them are my juniors, so I don't know if I'd call them friends per se.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But still... I really wasn't expecting to get birthday wishes like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Next, Ena, we'll interview someone I know you're dying to hear from!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, I recognize this place from streams...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <And here I am, having ambushed the ladies of MORE MORE JUMP! during their break!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Memories with Ena? How long have you got? I could tell you 10 or even 20 stories!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Hehe, that's our Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <So dependable! Well then, please share a story that'll make good content♪>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Good content...? Hmm... I know, I'll tell you about this one time not long after we first became friends!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <One time, just before Ena's birthday, we sorta fell out with each other.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <You and Ena? That's not like you two.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Exactly. We'd never fought before that, so we didn't really know how to make up. It was pretty tough.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And then Ena's birthday came. I didn't know if I'd get to give it to her, but I brought her present to school anyway.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Just then... I ran into Ena by the shoe lockers.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <That must have been awkward...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <A-And then what happened?!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <That's just it. The second we see each other, Ena comes out with this.>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: <It's...my birthday today.>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: <And I want birthday wishes from you, so... Let's make up.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And so, I got to hand her the present.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <To this day, I still sometimes remember how Ena acted that time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'd totally forgotten about that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But also, I can't believe Airi remembers... It was so long ago.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Ena looks kind of happy.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
<And now...
Last but not least...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Ta-da! Who else was it gonna be?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, I figured as much.
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And so... We'll be capping off our special movie with us three!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We spend so much time working together, so we gotta give Ena a good message♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A good message...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Can't we just speak normally?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Help me out here Mafuyu! Get a little more excited!>

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: Sheesh, Mafuyu never changes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um, a memory with Ena...? I'm not sure what to talk about.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hahaha, there are too many to pick, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <There was the doll exhibit, the mystery tour, the time we went to PXL... We've done so much together.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah. Most days we're just working together...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But when I look back, Ena's helped me out on more than one occasion.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <For sure. She's done so much for me too.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Me too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Though, I think she's pretty hard on me! The difference in how she treats Kanade and me is like night and day!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Isn't that your own fault, Mizuki?>

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: Exactly, Mafuyu! A stopped clock is right twice a day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whaaat? Do you think so...? Anyway, we're getting off track!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We've been through a lot together, but I guess what we want to say all boils down to this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Thank you for everything, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay, here we go guys! One, two, three!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade, Mafuyu & Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Ena.>
<Happy birthday, Ena!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And that concludes this special movie! Did you like it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Have a great rest of your birthday, Ena! Bye bye!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, it's over.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <This explains why Mizuki seemed so busy lately.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No kidding. I need to remember to say thanks later.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You too, Rin. Thank you for coming to wish me a happy birthday. I'm glad you stopped by.
One hour later
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, welcome home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... Why are you still in the living room?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can be wherever I want in my own home, can't I?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. I saw that video Mizuki made as a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, that thing Akiyama was recording while running all over the place?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, and you were the only person who didn't say something nice. Surely you can come up with one good memory?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pipe down. Like I said, I don't have any.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Ugh, rude...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Are you two squabbling again? You never learn, do you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, hi Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Welcome home, Akito. You ate out for dinner, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I got something with Toya and everyone.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Okay. Also... Did you get the things I asked for?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh... I did...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean? What did she ask for?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your cakes. Mom texted to say she was busy, so I got them on the way home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, little cheesecakes topped with fruit. They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Take what you want. I'll just pick whatever.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm.... Okay, I'll have this apple one. Happy birthday to me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
...!
What the heck, this is delicious!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh yeah? Well, I just picked all of them at random.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? Hehe, someone's not being honest with himself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is exactly the kind of cake I like. You put thought into picking them out, didn't you? Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I just went to a shop I'd wanted to check out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh, really? Damn, I wasted my thanks.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you should thank me for buying these in the first place...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Anyway, I'll have this one. I'm gonna eat it in my room.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait! Those strawberries look really good too. You have two, so let me have one!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey! Get your hands off my cake!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: That's enough, you two! You can at least stop fighting on someone's birthday!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine... Just this once.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks! Hmm, it's so good!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ena. I didn't say much in the video, but I hope I got it across that I wished you a happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami was so nervous all day, worrying about giving a good interview.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What? No, I... Maybe a little...
Um, once again Ena, happy birthday. Let me make you an apple pie sometime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ena! Did you like my song?!
Let's sing together sometime! It'll make you super wonderhoy inside!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Ena!
Oh, me and Kohane went to get you a present after our interview, so we'll get Akito to give it to you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We picked out some cosmetics that we thought would suit you. I hope you like it. Once again, happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ena.
Akito talks about you a lot, and his stories always make me think how close you are as siblings.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, no, we aren't. She even stole my strawberry.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sure, it's your birthday, but...
Maybe learn a little self-control?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ena, happy birthday!
Let's go exercise together again, and invite Airi and the others this time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to join you for that. Ena, happy birthday. I hope you have a great year ahead.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ena!
I always love going shopping with you. I hope we can go on many more outings together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'd be nice to do some reminiscing, so let's get together for tea sometime! I said it already, but happy birthday, Ena! I'm gonna keep giving you birthday wishes until we're old and gray!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ena.
I have so many memories that I tripped on my words in the video... But really, thank you for everything.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I feel the same. Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Can I just say, I walked all over the place shooting that video, and now my feet are killing me! I feel like I got in enough steps for the whole year!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm gonna say it one last time. Happy birthday, Ena! Here's to another year together as friends!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I never imagined I'd get a video like that on my birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was kinda embarrassing, but it made me happy. How can I put it...? I really felt seen, by so many people.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you for always watching over me. I'm going to keep doing my best, so I guess... I hope you stick around.
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, it's a quarter till...
I should log in to Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then, we can pick this conversation back up when Enanan gets here... Oh...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, look who it is! Good timing♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I thought I heard my name just now...
Were you talking about what we'll be working on today?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <We were talking about tickets for the Bridal Fair.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? Bridal Fair?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah! The Phoenix Bridal Fair!
They're apparently bringing it back!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Remember? K invited us the last time around.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You and K were invited by Honami after she received some tickets from Emu, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I actually received another ticket for this year, but I need to go visit my dad...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Also...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My dad is coming over this weekend...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I see...
Yeah, that does sorta take priority.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I also received a ticket, but I've got work and this anime event I've really been wanting to go to. Total overlap.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We were just talking about how it'd be a shame to have our tickets go to waste.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Which reminded us of you!
You couldn't go last time because you had art class that day.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, but...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hang on. Does this mean you're giving me your ticket?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Bingo!
I'll post the schedule for it in chat now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thanks, I'll take a look.
Let's see... Can I go...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, these days should work for me!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Really? Thank goodness.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <At least one of our tickets will get used now!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But the three of you aren't free, right?
